after.summary: Following severe nationwide riots, retail looting, and widespread protests across Paris and Lyon that drew 800,000 demonstrators, the yield on France's 10-year government bonds surpassed 5% for the first time in 24 years. President Emmanuel Macron condemned violent unrest as security forces deployed tear gas and water cannons, while financial markets reacted to widening debt risk premiums over Germany.
